# xdp.es DNS - High-Performance Recursive Resolver

> xdp.es provides a public, high-speed, zero-logging recursive DNS resolver with full DNSSEC validation, Ad/Malware blocking, and modern encryption protocols (DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS).

## Quick Endpoints

- **DNS over HTTPS (DoH)**: `https://dns.xdp.es/dns-query` (RFC 8484, HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 QUIC)
- **DNS over TLS (DoT)**: `dns.xdp.es` (Port 853, TLS 1.3)
- **Standard IPv4 DNS**: `85.208.114.51` (Port 53 UDP/TCP)
- **Standard IPv6 DNS**: `2a0e:97c0:c40::51` (Port 53 UDP/TCP)
- **Live Anonymized Metrics API**: `https://xdp.es/stats.json`
- **Interactive Dashboard**: `https://xdp.es/stats`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: `https://xdp.es/openapi.json`

## Machine & Agent Usage

### 1. DNS over HTTPS (DoH)
- Send `GET https://dns.xdp.es/dns-query?dns=<base64url-encoded-query>` with `Accept: application/dns-message`
- Or send `POST https://dns.xdp.es/dns-query` with binary payload and `Content-Type: application/dns-message`

### 2. Live Metrics API (`/stats.json`)
- `GET https://xdp.es/stats.json` returns real-time JSON containing 24-hour and 30-day resolution statistics:
  - `stats_24h.total`: Total queries processed in the last 24 hours.
  - `stats_24h.blocked`: Total queries filtered/blocked.
  - `stats_24h.blocked_pct`: Percentage of queries blocked.
  - `stats_24h.cached`: Total queries resolved from in-memory cache.
  - `stats_24h.cached_pct`: Cache hit ratio.
  - `stats_24h.avg_duration`: Average resolution latency in milliseconds.
  - `stats_24h.top_asns`: List of top autonomous systems by traffic volume with IPv4/IPv6 splits.
  - `stats_24h.top_query_types`: Breakdown of DNS query types (A, AAAA, HTTPS, DS, etc.).

### 3. Apple Device Auto-Configuration
- **DoH Mobileconfig Profile**: `https://xdp.es/dns_xdp_es_doh.mobileconfig`
- **DoT Mobileconfig Profile**: `https://xdp.es/dns_xdp_es_dot.mobileconfig`

## Full Documentation & Specifications
- For full agent specification and schema details, see: `https://xdp.es/llms-full.txt`
